 Television DC Correspondent 13 Nov 2026 1:01 PM IST 13 Nov 2026 1:01 PM IST Qazi Touqeer, Scout Op, Yung DSA, Gullu, Kanika Mann, Uditi Singh, Amrapali Dubey, Manish Goel, and Mahhi Vij have been nominated for this week's elimination.
 x Salman Khan. As Preferred
Source Bigg Boss 20 is all set to witness a double elimination this weekend. Yes, what you read is right. The show organizers skipped last week's elimination due to Diwali celebrations, so they will likely evict two contestants in the upcoming weekend episode.
 Qazi Touqeer, Scout Op, Yung DSA, Gullu, Kanika Mann, Uditi Singh, Amrapali Dubey, Manish Goel, and Mahhi Vij have been nominated for this week's elimination.
 Going by the voting trends on social media, Amrapali and Manish are in the danger zone with fewer votes. If there is a double eviction, Amrapali and Manish could leave the house.
 Let’s wait and see who gets eliminated this weekend.
